DHAKA, Feb 22, 2023 (BSS) - Speakers at a meeting today said that Bangladesh, being a Commonwealth member state, has a huge scope for boosting export of agricultural items to the UK market through availing duty free and quota free access facilities.

But for this, they suggested the government and the policy makers to ensure international standard accredited lab certificates, diversification in export items, quality control from production stage to shipment, packaging and supplying bacteria free
